lines.speaker: Early Adopter
lines.text: Wow, can you see into the future or something?

lines.speaker: Early Adopter
lines.text: There are only 50 food rations in our shelter,

lines.speaker: Early Adopter
lines.text: but about 30 starving people arrived at our shelter yesterday.

lines.speaker: Early Adopter
lines.text: We had no choice but to take them in.

lines.speaker: Early Adopter
lines.text: But when we did, you should get a look of the people here...

lines.speaker: Tooth-Missing Fan
lines.text: Let me guess, they looked like they wanna kill the newcomers?

lines.speaker: Early Adopter
lines.text: I feel like something's gonna go down soon.
